title: Implement JSON output adapter
description: Implement a JSON output adapter that produces a flat key-value map suitable for Style Dictionary or other tooling. Output format: { "--background-canvas": "#FBF8F1", ... }. Includes both light and dark mode tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Output is flat map of CSS custom property name to resolved value
Includes both light and dark mode tokens

evidence.context: JSON adapter is the first community-facing output format
